title: This and Stranger Things s5 (red Meltie mug)
notes: Same Short as meltie-fondue-mug, now with the RED variant of the real Meltie Mini Fondue Mug (store photo IMG_3997 + the red lifestyle photo IMG-4084). Hands only, so every shot starts from a keyframe built as an edit of the product photos + the bible set frame + the bible props (same room and props in every shot). Laptop screens show people-free scenes; the wafer wrapper is unbranded; Sora audio.

product.name: Meltie Mug Mini Fondue Mug, red
product.description: the RED Meltie Mini Fondue Mug exactly as in the product photos: glossy bright red ceramic body that flares wider at the top, a white interior, 'Chocolate...' in white cursive script with a small white swirl/® mark on the front, a tall arched opening at the base for a tealight, an angular red handle on the right with a small round hole, and a fondue fork with a red handle and long steel tines that clips into the handle

style: Vertical smartphone video filmed at night at a home desk, close camera at desk height; warm, cosy, slightly moody colour grade with a deep red wall light; hands have long light-grey manicured nails. One continuous take: no cuts, no zooms. Realistic. No on-screen text, no logos.

mug.desc: the RED Meltie Mini Fondue Mug exactly as in the product photos: glossy bright red ceramic body that flares wider at the top, a white interior, 'Chocolate...' in white cursive script with a small white swirl/® mark on the front, a tall arched opening at the base for a tealight, an angular red handle on the right with a small round hole, and a fondue fork with a red handle and long steel tines that clips into the handle

laptop.desc: a dark-grey open laptop whose bright screen shows a dim cinematic night scene with no people

tree.desc: a small Christmas tree, about 60 cm tall, with warm white fairy lights

torch.desc: a small black pocket butane torch lighter

wrapper.desc: a plain red chocolate-wafer bar wrapper with no text or logo, torn open

board.desc: a rectangular light-wood serving board with chocolate chip cookies, rows of round milk-chocolate malt balls, white marshmallows and halved strawberries on waffle pieces

D.desc: a home desk at night in a DIM room: a clean white desk top across the bottom 30% of the frame, a dark wall washed in deep red light behind, deep shadows, warm low light, no bright studio light; close camera at desk height
D.layout: The red fondue mug stands empty in the centre of the desk and is BIG: about 40% of the frame width, its base at 80% of the frame height; the open laptop on the left with its bright screen filling the upper-left third; the small lit Christmas tree in the upper-right quarter.

keyframe.prompt: The mug, full of melted milk chocolate with a lit tealight in its base, stands at the lower centre (BIG: 45% of the frame width, vertically 45-82%). A hand from the right holds the mug's red-handled fondue fork with a chocolate-dipped strawberry just above the mug. The laptop screen top-left shows a red neon retro title card on black (no text legible). The corner of the wooden snack board with marshmallows and strawberries enters at the bottom-left.

shots.prompt: The hand lifts the chocolate-coated strawberry out of the mug, chocolate dripping; slow drift closer. Keep the mug exactly as in the first frame.

shots.prompt: The hand turns the empty mug slightly toward the camera to show the 'Chocolate...' script and the empty tealight opening. Keep the mug exactly as in the first frame.
